items.title: Sheila Jordan interviewed by Monk Rowe, Middleburgh, New York, May 11, 2002
items.q: He said, “I have a song that I think you could really sing.” And he played it and he gave me a tape of him singing it and playing it

ctx.x: It’s an old Scottish folk song. It’s an old, I think it’s Scottish. It’s either Scottish or British. I think it’s from Scotland though. I think so. And he played that for me. He said, “I have a song that I think you could really sing.” And he played it and he gave me a tape of him singing it and playing it and I started to cry. I said oh my God this is so beautiful. Actually on the back of the original that that’s on, “Lost and Found” I thanked him for giving me that.
Do you do your own booking and business?
